cases.prompt: The robot arm picks up a small object from the table and places it beside the other objects. A stationary camera records the movement.
Pick up the object and place it next to the other objects.
A potter shapes a clay bowl on a spinning wheel. The quiet room has the soft sound of the wheel rotating and hands touching wet clay.

scope: Full Generator encode/denoise/decode; eager for all modes; sampling wall time is not a performance result
policy_input_limit: Robot observation images; bridge_orig_lerobot interface/domain selected, without matched action ground truth. Not a task success benchmark.
ffn: BF16 baseline; budget modes share model-local RTN W0/W1 and choose base, half/full A, full W, or their first-order combination. BF16 attention. W1 remains allocated across tiers.
audio_placement: Audio decoder stays on CPU. Save generated sound latents; waveform decoding runs separately after the Transformer is released. AV wall time excludes waveform decode.

budget_policy.scope: Greedy local error improvement per measured incremental ms, subject to per-task additional-FP4-product FLOP ceiling. Not a global optimum or quality guarantee.
budget_policy.runtime: Layer/CFG/normalized-step tier table; partial A supports recomputed on GPU from current-input energy. No output reuse. W1 kept dense to share storage across tiers.
